items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The fellow's dead now, poor John Slingsby. He got me a whole lot of times on the piano. Oh he recorded you on tape? Yeah.

ctx.x: You know I never touch this piano. But still you can remember them and I got a very good idea how it sounded. Really very interesting, your left hand. Yeah. It is.

The fellow's dead now, poor John Slingsby. He got me a whole lot of times on the piano. Oh he recorded you on tape? Yeah. Oh yeah. And he's dead now. Yeah. Who got his tapes? I don't know. Ah. Ah. Ah.
Ah. Ah. Ah. Ah. Ah. Ah. Ah. Ah. Ah. Ah. Ah.
